description: Southern Provincial Council - Statute of Agriculture, No. 03 of 2019
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns the enactment of a new provincial statute (the Agricultural Precept of the Southern Provincial Council) and establishes a detailed legal and regulatory framework for agricultural development. It creates a new government department, defines its powers, objectives, and duties, and outlines its organizational structure. This fits the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) as it involves the creation of new subsidiary legislation and regulatory provisions under provincial authority, rather than focusing on specific government personnel appointments or structural changes without legal framework creation.
